correctness.rationale: For each bundle counts (A+,A0,B+,B0), connectivity iff singleton or positive support on both parts; positive removable if it leaves one vertex or both parts nonempty, exactly the displayed predicate R. For each low value t, labelled EGF product (P_t+Q_{t+1})^k allows exactly those bundles and subtracting Q_{t+1}^k rules out an all-high double count. Summing over t counts each partition once; four factorials allocate distinct vertices. All-one H_s formula follows from connected s-bundle composition and q/q+1 sizes. Independently enumerated K_{2,4} labelled allocations give (1,12,0,288,960,720); finite example is not proof. Repaired RESULT and SLOGAN include complete claim/proof and correctly credit known existence.
